face_topology.json contains triangle indices derived from
MediaPipe FaceLandmarksConnections.FACE_LANDMARKS_TESSELATION in
mediapipe/tasks/python/vision/face_landmarker.py.

Copyright 2023 The MediaPipe Authors.

See MEDIAPIPE_LICENSE.txt for the license text.

This project deduplicates triangle edges for wireframe rendering and uses
the first 468 face landmarks. No MediaPipe model weights are included here.
